strings.tierB.home.title: FieldSales: Software fɔ Van Sales ɛn Sales Rep dɛn
strings.tierB.home.description: Software fɔ distributors: invoice ɛn receipt frɔm di rep in fon, van stock, mɔni kɔlɛkshɔn, rod ɛn visit dɛn. I de wok we nɛtwɔk nɔ de sɛf, ɛn sync leta.
strings.tierB.home.h1: Manej yu sales rep dɛn frɔm di fɔs visit te di las kɔlɛkshɔn
strings.tierB.home.definition: FieldSales na cloud platform (van sales ɛn sales rep software) fɔ distribution ɛn wholesale kɔmpin dɛn we gɛt sales rep dɛn na fil. Di rep dɛn de mek ɛn print invoice ɛn receipt frɔm dɛn fon, dɛn de chɛk van stock ɛn rayt dɛn visit dɛn, ɛn di manija dɛn de si sales, kɔlɛkshɔn ɛn wetin ɛni kɔstɔma gɛt fɔ pe jɔs as i de apin.
strings.tierB.home.capabilities.0.title: Invoice frɔm di rep in fon
strings.tierB.home.capabilities.0.line: Di rep de mek di invoice na di kɔstɔma in shɔp do ɛn print am na Bluetooth thermal printer bifo i kɔmɔt na di shɔp.
strings.tierB.home.capabilities.1.title: Mɔni kɔlɛkshɔn ɛn kɔstɔma balans
strings.tierB.home.capabilities.1.line: Ɛni pemɛnt gɛt receipt wit nɔmba we link to di invoice dɛn we i pe fɔ, ɛn di kɔstɔma in balans ɛn stetmɛnt de chenj wantɛm.
strings.tierB.home.capabilities.2.title: Wach di van stock
strings.tierB.home.capabilities.2.line: Di sistɛm de chɛk ɛni van in stock wan wan: wetin dɛn lod, wetin dɛn sɛl, wetin dɛn ritɔn ɛn wetin lɛf, so if ɛnitin mis, yu go si am di sem de.
strings.tierB.home.capabilities.3.title: Rod ɛn visit dɛn
strings.tierB.home.capabilities.3.line: Ɛni visit de sev wit lokeshɔn, tɛm ɛn pikchɔ dɛn, ɛn di manija de si ɛni rep in rod pan map.
strings.tierB.home.capabilities.4.title: I de wok we intanɛt nɔ de
strings.tierB.home.capabilities.4.line: Di rep dɛn kin kɔntinyu fɔ sɛl we nɛtwɔk nɔ de sɛf. Di pepa dɛn de wet na di fon ɛn sync dɛnsɛf we nɛtwɔk kam bak, ɛn wan pepa nɔ de go tu tɛm.
strings.tierB.home.capabilities.5.title: Web dashboard fɔ manija dɛn
strings.tierB.home.capabilities.5.line: Sales, kɔlɛkshɔn, ritɔn, stock ɛn aw ɛni rep de du, ɔl na wan ples, wit roles ɛn permissions fɔ ɛni pɔsin we de yuz am.
strings.tierB.home.howItWorks.0.title: Tɛl wi aw yu de sɛl
strings.tierB.home.howItWorks.0.line: Aks fɔ quote ɔ buk mitin. Wi go luk yu rep dɛn, yu rod dɛn, yu products ɛn wetin yu nid fɔ invoice.
strings.tierB.home.howItWorks.1.title: Sɛt ɔp yu kɔmpin
strings.tierB.home.howItWorks.1.line: Ad yu products, prays, kɔstɔma ɛn rep dɛn, ɛn sɛt yu kɔntri in mɔni ɛn taks ret na di settings.
strings.tierB.home.howItWorks.2.title: Sɛn di rep dɛn go na fil
strings.tierB.home.howItWorks.2.line: Di rep dɛn de instɔl di app na Android ɔ iPhone, lod dɛn van ɛn bigin fɔ sɛl, print ɛn kɔlɛkt mɔni.
strings.tierB.home.howItWorks.3.title: Fala di de as i de apin
strings.tierB.home.howItWorks.3.line: Di web dashboard de sho sales, kɔlɛkshɔn, van stock ɛn visit dɛn we di rep dɛn stil de pan rod.
strings.tierB.home.faq.0.a: FieldSales na cloud platform fɔ manej sales rep dɛn na distribution ɛn wholesale kɔmpin dɛn. I kɔba van sales, route sales, pre-sales (fɔ tek ɔda fɔs) ɛn direct store delivery (DSD). Di rep dɛn de mek invoice, print, kɔlɛkt mɔni ɛn rayt visit frɔm dɛn fon, ɛn di manija dɛn de fala sales, kɔlɛkshɔn, van stock ɛn kɔstɔma balans frɔm web dashboard.
strings.tierB.home.faq.1.q: FieldSales de wok we intanɛt nɔ de?
strings.tierB.home.faq.1.a: Yɛs. Di rep app de wok we intanɛt nɔ de: di rep dɛn kin mek ɛn print invoice ɛn receipt, rayt visit ɛn ad nyu kɔstɔma, ɛn ɔltin go sync insɛf we nɛtwɔk kam bak, ɛn wan pepa nɔ go go tu tɛm. Wan ɛksɛpshɔn de fɔ Saudi Arabia: kɔmpin dɛn we dɔn ɔn e-invoicing integration nid kɔnɛkshɔn di tɛm we dɛn de mek invoice ɔ ritɔn.
strings.tierB.home.faq.2.q: Us kɔntri dɛn FieldSales de sav?
strings.tierB.home.faq.2.a: FieldSales de sav distribution kɔmpin dɛn na ɛni kɔntri. Ɛni kɔmpin de sɛt in yon mɔni ɛn taks ret na in settings, ɛn invoice, receipt ɛn ripɔt dɛn de yuz dɛn. FieldSales bes na Riyadh, Saudi Arabia, ɛn wi de ɛp yu bigin ɔnlayn: mitin, WhatsApp ɛn sɔpɔt frɔm fa.
strings.tierB.home.faq.3.q: FieldSales kin kɔnɛkt to gɔvmɛnt e-invoicing sistɛm dɛn?
strings.tierB.home.faq.3.a: Wi de sɔpɔt Phase 2 integration wit ZATCA in Fatoora platform. Dis na fɔ kɔmpin dɛn na Saudi Arabia. Na ɔda kɔntri dɛn, Salone inklud, FieldSales de mek invoice wit yu mɔni ɛn yu taks ret, ɛn kɔnɛkshɔn to di kɔntri in nashɔnal e-invoicing sistɛm de if yu aks, afta wi ɛn yu dɔn luk di kɔntri in rul dɛn. Wi nɔ de prɔmis se i go fala di rul dɛn na ɛni ɔda kɔntri pas Saudi Arabia.
strings.tierB.home.faq.4.q: Us langwej dɛn di FieldSales app gɛt?
strings.tierB.home.faq.4.a: Di FieldSales app intafes de na Arabik, Inglish, Frɛnch, Tɔkish ɛn Chayniz, ɛn na dɛn langwej dɛn nɔmɔ. Krio nɔ de insay, bɔt Inglish de pan dɛn. Di rep dɛn ɛn manija dɛn kin chenj di intafes langwej, ɛn invoice we dɛn print kin kɛr sɛkɔn langwej nia di men wan. Website pej dɛn na ɔda langwej, lɛk dis Krio pej, na translet fɔ gi infɔmeshɔn bɔt di prodak.
strings.tierB.home.faq.5.q: Aw a go bigin wit FieldSales?
strings.tierB.home.faq.5.a: Aks fɔ quote, buk mitin ɔ sɛn wi mɛsej na WhatsApp. Wi go lan aw yu rep dɛn de wok, dɔn wi go ɛp yu sɛt ɔp products, prays, kɔstɔma ɛn rep dɛn. Di rep dɛn de instɔl di app na Android ɔ iPhone, ɛn di manija dɛn de yuz di web dashboard na ɛni browser. Na smartphone nɔmɔ yu nid.
strings.tierB.home.uiLanguagesNote: Di FieldSales app intafes de na Arabik, Inglish, Frɛnch, Tɔkish ɛn Chayniz; Krio nɔ de insay. Pej dɛn na ɔda langwej de tɔk bɔt di prodak fɔ infɔmeshɔn nɔmɔ.
strings.tierB.category.title: Van Sales Software fɔ Distributors na Salone | FieldSales
strings.tierB.category.description: Van sales ɛn route sales software: di rep de print invoice frɔm fon, van stock wan wan, mɔni kɔlɛkshɔn ɛn visit dɛn. I de wok we intanɛt nɔ de.
strings.tierB.category.h1: Van sales software fɔ distributors ɛn wholesalers na Salone
strings.tierB.category.intro: FieldSales na van sales software fɔ kɔmpin dɛn we dɛn rep dɛn de sɛl frɔm van pan dɛn rod ɛni de. Di rep de lod di van, sɛl na ɛni shɔp, print di invoice, kɔlɛkt mɔni ɛn rayt ritɔn dɛn, ɔl frɔm wan fon app. Di manija de si wetin dɛn lod, sɛl, kɔlɛkt ɛn wetin lɛf na ɛni van.
strings.tierB.category.sections.0.title: Wetin na van sales software?
strings.tierB.category.sections.0.body: Van sales software, we pipul dɛn kin kɔl cash van ɔ route sales software bak, de rɔn wan kayn sɛlin usay di rep kɛr stock na di mɔto ɛn sɛl, delivas, mek invoice ɛn kɔlɛkt mɔni na wan visit. I de tek di ples fɔ di pepa invoice buk ɛn di fon kɔl dɛn na ivintɛm. I de rayt ɛni sel, ɛni pemɛnt ɛn ɛni ritɔn as pepa, so yu kin chɛk di stock ɛn di mɔni wan pan di ɔda di sem de. Fɔ manija, i de ansa tri kwɛstyɔn ɛni ivintɛm: wetin ɛni rep sɛl, wetin ɛni rep kɔlɛkt, ɛn wetin stil de na ɛni van?
strings.tierB.category.sections.1.title: Wan de pan rod
strings.tierB.category.sections.1.body: Di de de bigin wit lod we dɛn rayt dɔŋ frɔm di warehouse to di van. Na ɛni shɔp, di rep de pik di kɔstɔma na di app, ad items frɔm list ɔ barcode, mek di invoice ɛn print am na thermal printer. Dɛn de rayt pemɛnt wit receipt, ɛn dɛn de rayt ɛni ritɔn wit in rizin. We di de dɔn, wetin lɛf na di van de go bak na di warehouse. Bitwin ɔl dat, di manija kin fala ɛni rep in sales, kɔlɛkshɔn ɛn visit frɔm di web dashboard, ɛn i nɔ nid fɔ kɔl ɛnibɔdi.
strings.tierB.category.sections.2.title: Mek fɔ ples dɛn we nɛtwɔk wik
strings.tierB.category.sections.2.body: Distribution rod dɛn de pas rum dɛn ɔnda grɔn, industrial eria ɛn vilej dɛn we nɛtwɔk nɔ gud. Di FieldSales rep app de kip kɔstɔma, products ɛn prays na di fon, so di rep kin mek ɛn print pepa dɛn we intanɛt nɔ de. Ɛni pepa gɛt in yon spɛshal ki (unique key), so i de go ɔp wan tɛm nɔmɔ, ivin if dɛn tray bak. Saudi kɔmpin dɛn we dɔn ɔn e-invoicing integration nid kɔnɛkshɔn di tɛm we dɛn de mek invoice ɛn ritɔn. Receipt, visit ɛn nyu kɔstɔma stil de wok we intanɛt nɔ de fɔ dɛn bak.
strings.tierB.category.sections.3.title: Mɔni kɔlɛkshɔn ɛn fɔ wach di van
strings.tierB.category.sections.3.body: Mɔni we de pan rod nid di sem kɔntrol lɛk stock. Ɛni kɔlɛkshɔn gɛt receipt wit nɔmba we kin link to di invoice dɛn we i pe fɔ, ɛn di kɔstɔma in balans de chenj wantɛm. Dɛn de kɔnt di van stock wan wan: wetin dɛn lod, tek kɔmɔt wetin dɛn sɛl, ad di ritɔn ɛn di ajɔstmɛnt dɛn we dɛn rayt dɔŋ, so di manija dɛn kin kɔmpia am wit di rial kɔnt bifo di rep go os. Dɛn kin sɔt ritɔn dɛn as nɔmal, spɔyl ɔ ɛkschenj, ɛn na di manija de disayd if di ritɔn gudz go bak insay di van stock we dɛn kin sɛl.
strings.tierB.category.sections.4.title: Na udat i fɔ?
strings.tierB.category.sections.4.body: FieldSales fit distributors ɛn wholesalers we de sɛl gudz we de muv kwik (FMCG), lɛk fud, drink, sop ɛn tin fɔ klin, ɛn bɔdi kia tin dɛn, ɛn ɛni kɔmpin we in rep dɛn de visit shɔp dɛn pan rod. I de sɔpɔt van sales, pre-sales ɔda ɛn direct store delivery. I nɔto ful ERP: i de kɔnɛkt to yu akawntin ɔ ERP sistɛm tru API. Di manija dɛn de kɔntrol wetin ɛni rep kin du, lɛk fɔ gi diskawnt, sɛl ɔnda di list prays ɔ ad nyu kɔstɔma.
strings.tierB.category.faq.0.q: Wetin na di difrɛns bitwin van sales ɛn pre-sales?
strings.tierB.category.faq.0.a: Na van sales, di rep kɛr stock ɛn delivas, mek invoice ɛn kɔlɛkt mɔni na di sem visit. Na pre-sales, di rep tek ɔda we di warehouse go delivas leta. FieldSales sɔpɔt di tu, so kɔmpin kin rɔn cash van pan sɔm rod ɛn tek ɔda pan ɔda rod. Na di tu we, invoice, kɔlɛkshɔn ɛn kɔstɔma balans de na di sem sistɛm, ɛn di manija dɛn de si dɛn na di sem ripɔt dɛn.
strings.tierB.category.faq.1.q: Aw a go balans van we di de dɔn?
strings.tierB.category.faq.1.a: FieldSales de sho, fɔ ɛni item na ɛni van, aw mɔch dɛn lod, sɛl, ritɔn ɛn wetin lɛf. Kɔmpia wetin lɛf wit di rial kɔnt, rayt ɛni difrɛns as ajɔstmɛnt we dɛn rayt dɔŋ, dɔn ɔnlod di res go bak na di warehouse wit wan muvmɛnt. Di van go bigin tumara wit klin balans we yu sabi.
strings.tierB.category.faq.2.q: Us hardware van sales rep nid?
strings.tierB.category.faq.2.a: Smartphone, Android ɔ iPhone. Bluetooth thermal printer nɔ fos; i de ɛp di rep fɔ gi di kɔstɔma invoice ɔ receipt we dɛn print. FieldSales nɔ de sɛl hardware ɛn i nɔ de fos yu fɔ yuz ɛni spɛshal printer brand. Di manija dɛn de yuz di web dashboard frɔm ɛni kɔmpyuta ɔ fon browser.
strings.tierB.category.faq.3.q: FieldSales kin kɔnɛkt to wi akawntin sistɛm?
strings.tierB.category.faq.3.a: Yɛs. FieldSales gɛt API we de mek yu akawntin ɔ ERP sistɛm sɛn ɛn gɛt kɔstɔma, products, invoice, receipt ɛn stock muvmɛnt frɔm di platform. Yu tim ɔ yu integrator de bil di kɔnɛkshɔn wit di API dokyumɛnt dɛn.
strings.tierB.countries.title: FieldSales Kɔntri bay Kɔntri: Mɔni, Taks ɛn E-Invoicing
strings.tierB.countries.description: FieldSales de wok fɔ distributors na ɛni kɔntri. Si ɛni kɔntri in mɔni, taks ɛn e-invoicing stetɔs na wan tebul.
strings.tierB.countries.intro: FieldSales de sav distribution kɔmpin dɛn na ɛni kɔntri. Ɛni kɔmpin de pik in kɔntri, in mɔni ɛn in taks ret na in settings, ɛn invoice, receipt ɛn ripɔt dɛn de fala dɛn. Gɔvmɛnt e-invoicing integration de wok na Saudi Arabia nɔmɔ. Na ɔl di ɔda kɔntri dɛn, i de if yu aks. Di tebul ya dɔŋ de sho, fɔ ɛni kɔntri, di mɔni, di nɔmal sales taks ɔ VAT ret, ɛn if gɔvmɛnt e-invoicing kɔnɛkshɔn de wok ɔ i de if yu aks.
strings.tierB.countries.einvoicingLive: Wi de sɔpɔt Phase 2 integration wit ZATCA in Fatoora platform
strings.tierB.countries.taxNote: Ɛni kɔmpin de sɛt di mɔni ɛn taks ret na in yon settings. Di ret dɛn na dis tebul na jɔs gayd ɛn dɛn kin chenj; chɛk di rul dɛn we de naw wit yu taks advaysa. Dash (—) min se nɔ jenɛral ret de na di tebul fɔ da kɔntri de.
strings.tierB.about.title: Bɔt FieldSales
strings.tierB.about.description: FieldSales de bil cloud software fɔ distribution kɔmpin dɛn we gɛt sales rep dɛn pan rod. Dɛn stat am na 2026 na Riyadh, Saudi Arabia.
strings.tierB.about.body.0: FieldSales (in Arabik nem na فيلد سيلز) na cloud platform fɔ distribution ɛn wholesale kɔmpin dɛn we gɛt sales rep dɛn pan rod. Dɛn stat di kɔmpin na 2026, ɛn i bes na Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. I de sav kɔmpin dɛn na ɛni kɔntri, ɛn ɛni kɔmpin de sɛt in kɔntri in mɔni ɛn taks ret na in yon settings. Wi kɔstɔma dɛn na kɔmpin dɛn we de sɛl ɛn delivas tru rep dɛn pan rod: distributors, wholesalers ɛn manufacturers we gɛt dɛn yon sales mɔto dɛn.
strings.tierB.about.body.1: Wi de bil wan sistɛm we kɔnɛkt ɔl di wok na fil: invoice we di rep print frɔm in fon, receipt ɛn kɔstɔma balans, van stock kɔntrol, rod ɛn visit wit lokeshɔn ɛn pikchɔ, ɛn web dashboard fɔ manija dɛn. Di rep app de wok na Android ɛn iPhone, i kin kɔntinyu fɔ wok we intanɛt nɔ de, dɔn i go sync we nɛtwɔk kam bak. Kɔmpin dɛn kin kɔnɛkt FieldSales to dɛn akawntin ɔ ERP sistɛm tru API, so dɛn nɔ nid fɔ tayp di fil data tu tɛm.
strings.tierB.about.body.2: Wi de tɔk bɔt di prodak jɔs aw i bi. Wi de sɔpɔt Phase 2 integration wit ZATCA in Fatoora platform. Integration wit gɔvmɛnt sistɛm dɛn na ɔda kɔntri dɛn de if yu aks. Di app intafes de na Arabik, Inglish, Frɛnch, Tɔkish ɛn Chayniz; Krio nɔ de insay. Fɔ tɔk to wi, aks fɔ quote, buk mitin ɔ sɛn wi mɛsej na WhatsApp.
strings.tierB.contact.title: Kɔntakt FieldSales
strings.tierB.contact.description: Tɔk to di FieldSales tim: aks fɔ quote, buk mitin ɔ chat wit wi na WhatsApp bɔt field sales ɛn van sales software.
strings.tierB.contact.intro: Tɛl wi aw yu rep dɛn de sɛl tide ɛn wetin yu want chenj. Aks fɔ quote, buk mitin ɔ sɛn wi mɛsej na WhatsApp, ɛn pɔsin frɔm wi tim go ansa yu. Fɔ sɔpɔt, kɔstɔma dɛn we dɔn de wit wi kin yuz di sem we dɛn. I go ɛp if yu tɛl wi yu kɔntri, aw mɔch rep yu gɛt, ɛn if dɛn de sɛl frɔm van, tek ɔda ɔ du di tu.
strings.tierB.contact.meetingIntro: Buk ɔnlayn mitin wit wi tim. Wi go sho yu wan rep in de insay di app ɛn di manija in dashboard, wit ɛgzampul dɛn we nia yu products ɛn yu rod dɛn, ɛn ansa yu kwɛstyɔn dɛn bɔt aw fɔ sɛt ɔp.
